findings.source_locator: PDF page 1, lines 28-53
findings.citation: G.O.Ms.No.394, Revenue (Registration.I) Department, dated 26-11-2014, supplied PDF page 1, paragraphs 1-3 and notification

stamp_duty: G.O.Ms.No.719 reduced sale-deed stamp duty from 7%/6% to 5% with effect from 01-09-2010
G.O.Ms.No.162 reduced sale-deed stamp duty from 5% to 4%; its effective date is not stated in the G.O.394 recital
G.O.Ms.No.394 rescinds G.O.Ms.No.162 and restores the G.O.Ms.No.719 level with immediate effect on 26-11-2014

findings.limitations: G.O.Ms.No.719 and G.O.Ms.No.162 are referenced but not supplied as full orders here. The recital gives the 2010 effective date and 2014 immediate restoration date, but does not state G.O.Ms.No.162's effective date or define all location/property-subtype scope. Does not establish transfer duty, registration fee, later changes after the latest supplied 2024 source, or treatment of deed-specific exemptions.
